components.artificial_score_inflation: Lines 526-527: confidence_score = round(max(best_prob * 100.0, 65.0), 1) and crop_confidence = round(min(confidence_score + 10.0, 99.2), 1). Artificially sets floor at 65% and fabricates crop confidence.

components.implementation: analyze_lesion_masking(cv_img, is_healthy) via OpenCV HSV brown/yellow thresholding.
components.critical_defect: Pure color heuristic with no semantic or pathological grounding. Flags dirt, shadows, leaf veins, and dried margins as lesions. Confuses farmers into believing AI has verified pathological lesions.

components.structure: Flat dictionary DISEASE_INFO with case-insensitive fallback. Missing structured links to plant parts, growth stages, look-alike differentials, and expert escalation criteria.
